reason: Our architect and in-house drafter already turn out renders and models as part of the plan package, so I'd be paying twice for something I already get. I'm not putting $1,500 a house on a library of 20-100 plans.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? If it shows a finish or a layout we won't build, I've got a buyer standing in my sales office pointing at something that isn't in the contract.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost a few hundred dollars per plan, covered my whole plan library with a model reused on every lot, and I could see it match one of my plans exactly at the free lunch demo, I'd try it for my model-home sales.
